notes.subject: פלגשיהם
notes.rationale: 'Their concubines/paramours' — most versions take the men of the lovers as referent with euphemistic plural; JPS reads 'concubinage with them'.

notes.subject: żerżiem
notes.rationale: זרמה is literally a gushing of fluid; kept as a coined noun from żerżaq rather than softened to 'issue'.

notes.subject: בשר…בשרם / זרמת…זרמתם
notes.rationale: Parallel repetition flesh-flesh, gushing-gushing builds the verse's bluntness; the repetition is kept intact.

translation: U xhaqdet għall-maħbubin tagħhom, li ġisimhom huwa bħall-ġisem tal-ħmir, u żerżiem żwiemel huwa żerżiemhom.
